artworks.title: Mary of Modena, as Duchess of York
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Banck after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-length portrait of a woman standing with one hand on draped fabric, and her other arm on an ornate pedestal. She is facing forward, with softly rendered facial features, defined eyebrows, a small nose, full lips, and hair styled in tight curls. She wears a detailed gown with voluminous sleeves, an embroidered hem, and pearls around her neck. Beside her, a large vase of detailed flowers and foliage is displayed. The background includes heavy drapery with tassels and a large column.

artworks.title: Tobias Matthew, Archbishop of York
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up, seated with one hand on an open book. His facial features include a serious expression, thin lips, prominent cheekbones, combed-back hair under a hat, and a high-collared garment with visible ruffled collar layers. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with Latin inscriptions, flanked by two angels holding trumpets on each side. The background features a family crest at the top, with intricate detailing, including angelic figures, scrolls, and flowers. The lower section includes Latin script.

artworks.title: Tobias Matthew, Archbishop of York
artworks.description: The image is a detailed portrait engraving of a man shown from the waist up. He is seated in a formal position, his body turned slightly to one side with his gaze directed outward towards the viewer. The man has a long, pointed beard and a mustache, with hair that is mostly covered by a cap that has a flat top. His facial expression is calm and serious, with lines visible on his forehead and around his eyes. He is wearing intricate clothing typical of the period, including a high, ruffled collar, a richly textured robe over a patterned vest, and puffy sleeves. In his hands, he is holding a book. The engraving includes a decorative oval frame with text surrounding his portrait, indicating his identity as "TOBIAS MATTHÆUS." The background is a simple pattern of horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Matthias, Roman Emperor and William I, Princeof Orange
artworks.description: In the image, two men are depicted in ornate oval frames from the waist up. Both men are standing formally, with one having short, curly hair and wearing armor with detailed patterns, and the other having short hair, a beard, and a mustache, also dressed in intricate armor. The background features decorative elements such as coats of arms, figures holding scrolls and musical instruments, and Latin inscriptions. The engraving is intricate and formal in style.

artworks.title: Emperor Matthias
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a neatly trimmed mustache and small goatee, a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, and curly hair. He wears a laurel wreath on his head and is dressed in a detailed outfit with a high lace ruff, fur-lined cape, and a chain with a pendant around his neck. The portrait is within an oval frame with an inscription, set against a background of hatch patterns. Below the oval, there is a block of text in elegant writing.

artworks.title: Matthias, Roman Emperor
artworks.description: The image displays an upper-body portrait of a man sitting on a throne, shown in three-quarters view. He is holding a scepter in one hand and resting the other on an orb on a draped table. The man has defined facial features with a mustache and beard, styled hair, and rich, ornate clothing including a high lace collar and a jeweled, embroidered robe with a chain across the chest. He wears a crown with intricate detailing and there is a large crown on the table. The background has dark, patterned drapery and curtains partially open to reveal a patterned window.

artworks.title: Emperor Matthias
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body. He is facing slightly to his right with a dignified pose. The man has an angular face, a trimmed mustache and goatee, and short, combed-back hair mostly covered by an ornate crown. He wears a richly decorated outfit with a high ruff collar, a chain with a medallion, and an embellished cloak. The background consists of engraved lines, creating a textured backdrop. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame with text identifying the man as Matthias I. Additional text beneath the portrait identifies him as an emperor and king of various regions.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man in an intricately designed frame with detailed engravings. He is positioned facing forward with a slight turn to his right. His hair is short and wavy, and he has a mustache and goatee. He wears a ruffled collar, a garment with decorative elements, and a sash. The background consists of cross-hatched lines. Below the portrait, there is some Latin text.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body, positioned slightly to the side but facing the viewer. The man has an oval-shaped face with prominent cheekbones and a slight smile. He has deep-set eyes beneath arched eyebrows, along with a beard and mustache. His hair is curly and styled upwards, shorter on the sides. The man is wearing a detailed garment, possibly a mix of metal and fabric, with a large, ornate ruff around his neck. The portrait is encased in an oval border with text and emblematic elements like shields and lions. The background features intricate line work.

artworks.title: Maurice, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: This is an engraving featuring a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man is positioned facing slightly to the right, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a prominent mustache and a slight goatee, with wavy hair and a distinct hairline. He is depicted wearing decorative armor and a detailed collar with a frilled edge. A coat of arms is displayed in the top left corner of the image. The background consists of fine lines, and the bottom of the engraving features inscribed text identifying the person, likely with their title and name.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a bust portrait of a man shown from the chest up, oriented forward. The man has distinctive facial features, including a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, and a pointed beard and mustache. His hair is styled with a slight wave and a short, voluminous cut. He is wearing ornate clothing typical of the late Renaissance or early Baroque period, featuring a high-collared shirt with intricate embroidery and detailed patterning, possibly armor with buttons and etched designs. Surrounding the portrait is an oval border with an inscription. The background is a simple, dark texture that contrasts with the figure, emphasizing his detailed features and attire.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.description: The image shows a man riding a horse. The man is on the back of the rearing horse, facing the viewer with a confident expression. He has an angular face, a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, and styled hair. He wears ornate armor with a breastplate, shin guards, and a high ruffled collar. A decorative plume flows from his helmet, and a large cloth billows behind him. In his right hand, he holds the horse’s reins, and in his left hand, he holds a baton pointing upwards. A coat of arms is displayed in the top right corner. The background features buildings and geographical features, giving the impression of an elevated view. Various figures are engaged in activity at the lower section of the image, depicting a scene of battle or fortification.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange

The man has short, curly hair and a neatly groomed beard. He wears intricately designed armor covering his whole body, including a high lace ruff around his neck and armored boots. He has a calm expression. Beside him, a large shield with a coat of arms rests on the ground. The background shows a detailed scene of a battle or military encampment, with troops and structures.

artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange

He has curly, short hair and is dressed in period attire with a high lace collar and a textured cloak. The background features a circular format with a Latin inscription. Below the portrait is decorative script.

artworks.title: Maurice, Prince of Orange

Their facial features include a stern expression with a lined face, a beard, and mustache, and wavy, combed-back light hair. The clothing is ornate, with a richly embroidered or patterned sash across one shoulder, a high-tiered ruffled collar, and a dark outer garment. The person wears a round medallion or pendant around their neck. The background is a simple texture, and the portrait is encased in an oval frame. The bottom of the print includes the text "MAVRITIVS NASSAVIVS, PRINCEPS AVRIACVS, etc.," with small decorative elements on the sides.

He is wearing an ornate jacket with decorative detailing and a high ruffled collar. There are no visible accessories. The background includes an oval frame with text around the perimeter and scribbled lines indicating a plain or textured backdrop. The portrait seems to be an engraved print, with a name or title and the year "1608" inscribed at the bottom.

He is dressed in a high-collared garment with intricate patterns and a cloak secured with a decorative brooch at his shoulder. The background features an oval frame with Latin inscriptions surrounding the portrait. The area outside the oval frame is shaded with horizontal lines for depth and contrast.

The man wears a formal garment with intricate patterns, a ruffled collar, and a medallion. The background includes an oval frame with surrounding text and radiating lines. The style appears to be an engraving or etching typical of earlier centuries.

artworks.title: Maurice, Prince of Orange

The man is dressed in elaborate historical clothing, wearing a dark robe with a high pleated collar and decorative embroidery. artworks.title: Maurice of Nassau, Prince of Orange
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe after Crispijn de Passe I
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up, centered within an oval frame. He is slightly turned to his right, with his head facing forward. The man has a middle-aged face with a short beard and mustache. His hair is short and neatly styled. He is dressed in period clothing with a high ruffled collar. The man is surrounded by scrollwork and decorative medallions. At the top of the frame, a cherub is blowing a horn-like structure. The background is filled with scrolling patterns and text.

artworks.title: Maurice, Prince of Orange on Horseback
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a man riding a horse. The man is upright in the saddle, with his head turned to the side. He appears to be wearing armor, a sash, and holding a baton. The horse is rearing on its hind legs and is adorned with a decorative bridle and saddle. In the background, there is a battle scene with an army formation and a castle or fortification. The sky is etched with sweeping lines.

They have a mustache, beard, short hair, and wear a dark, buttoned garment with a white ruffled collar. The portrait is framed in an oval design with surrounding text, against a lined background. The lower section contains additional text.

artworks.title: Thomas Maurois

He is positioned facing slightly to the right of the viewer, with a solemn expression on his face. The man has short hair, combed back, and a neatly trimmed mustache and goatee. He is wearing a large ruffled collar and a dark garment that appears to be buttoned down the front. The background is plain and features a decorative oval border with Latin text surrounding the figure. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held by the man. Below the oval border, there is additional Latin text framed within a rectangle.
